Author: platis
Name: XIV.fm
Punchline: Share what you are listening to in Final Fantasy XIV.
Description: XIV.fm displays Last.fm listening presence on cards anchored above player nameplates.
Changelog:
- Show the real connection state in settings, including retries, duty pauses, lost Relays, and links that need to be connected again.
- Add a live card preview and an optional card text outline, off by default, in Overlay settings.
- Use gold for primary settings controls and red only for destructive actions.
- Explain in Privacy who sees your card; selecting Relays no longer changes your visibility.
- Save Overlay sliders when released.
